meta: What is AI? You already use it every day. Artificial intelligence explained simply in under a minute: learning from examples, AI that predicts vs. generative AI, and why you should double-check.

muc.title: AI is all around you
muc.text: You use AI every day without noticing: suggested videos, unlocking with your face, a keyboard that fixes your typos.

muc.title: A machine doing the work of a mind
muc.text: AI, short for Artificial Intelligence, is a computer that can do things that used to need a human mind.

muc.title: Learning from examples
muc.text: Instead of writing every rule by hand, people show the machine lots of examples so it works out the rules on its own.

muc.title: AI that predicts, AI that creates
muc.text: Some AI is built to predict, like filtering spam, while generative AI writes text and draws pictures on its own.

muc.title: Smart, but sometimes wrong
muc.text: AI is smart but can be wrong with total confidence, so always double-check anything important.

muc.title: Ask about a hard word
muc.text: Try it now: ask a chatbot to explain a hard word from your line of work, as if talking to a fifth grader.
